description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Flexible' class, which is a specialized parser for safely converting variables to various data types based on specified types. It extends the base class 'HTMLPurifier_VarParser' and includes a method 'parseImplementation' that processes input variables according to their intended type, handling conversions and errors.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Flexible
classes.description: A class responsible for flexible and safe parsing of variables into specified data types, extending 'HTMLPurifier_VarParser'.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Performs type-aware parsing of a variable, converting it to the specified type while handling special cases, errors, and null values.
